August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 191)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network and regional radio, Chicago deejay king Howard Miller hosting two editions for Wrigley's Gum (welcoming the Chicago Theatre of the Air cast and reviewing 1957 pop chart hits), Jack Carson and Arthur Treacher in the US Treasury's Our Land Be Bright, Philip Clarke narrating the macabre thriller Time on My Hands on The Sealed Book, juvenile high-seas peril in The Adventures of the Sea Hound, and Richard Crenna in Mutual Radio Theater (1945–1980):
